result.justification: The research objective is clearly stated, addressing the need for comprehensive characterization of adenoviral diversity in Russia. The methodology is detailed, specifying sample collection, viral detection, sequencing, and analytical techniques.

objective_evidence.quote: the aim of this study is to generate a comprehensive dataset of complete adenovirus genomes representing the breadth of viral subtypes circulating in Russia

method_evidence.quote: Nucleic acids were extracted from 100 µL of the sample using the column-based DNA extraction kit 'Genomic DNA Extraction Kit from Cells, Tissues, and Blood' (Biolabmix DU-250)
